title: 230604_2442_FR_CrowdOutdoor.wav by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Noisy crowd waiting for an outdoor event. I made this recording while standing in the middle of the crowd, during ‘’Parades Festival’’, which is held in Nanterre (near Paris, France) every year at the beginning of June. One can hear a lot of people (adults and children) waiting outdoor, for a street event which shall happen soon. Most of them are chatting in French, but some other languages can be heard. Between 3’00’’ and 4’07’’, a kid on the left complains quite loudly. Recorded in June 2023 with an Olympus LS-P4 and a Rode Stereo videomic X (SVMX). Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
modifications: cut 149.83-164.83s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -9.00 dBFS); 30 ms fades
